# API Checklist: Rooms Catalog

**Purpose**: API contract quality: status codes, validation rules and error format
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Status Code Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Is every operation's set of outcomes (success, invalid input, unknown room, duplicate name) mapped to exactly one status in the contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008..FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified which success status creation returns and whether the new room's location is reported? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the status for "no rooms match the filters" stated as success with an empty list rather than an error? [Clarity, Spec §US1 Scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the outcome of activating an already active room (and deactivating an inactive one) stated consistently between the edge cases and the contract? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the status for a duplicate name consistent between creation and rename? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the precedence defined when a request is both invalid and refers to an unknown room? [Gap]

## Validation Rule Requirements

- [ ] CHK007 Are the limits on name length, capacity maximum, number of equipment items and item length stated in the spec, not only in the contract? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "whole number greater than zero" for capacity applied identically to creation, edit and the minimum-capacity filter? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the handling of a non-numeric or non-positive minimum capacity defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Are trimming, case-insensitive uniqueness and equipment de-duplication defined for every operation that accepts a name or equipment? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it defined what an empty or whitespace-only equipment filter means? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it defined whether unknown fields in a request body are ignored or rejected? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is it specified whether the room's active state can be changed through the edit operation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]

## Error Format Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Is every error response required to use the common error format, including validation failures raised by the framework? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "a message that names the cause" defined so that invalid-field errors identify the field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the duplicate-name message required to avoid revealing details of the other room? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the error responses reused consistently across all four operations in the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]

## Contract & Data Requirements

- [ ] CHK018 Does the spec define the response shape of deactivation, including the future-bookings entries, while bookings do not exist yet? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the ordering of the room list specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the "five to six demo rooms" requirement specific about their content, or only their count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified that the contract is updated before implementation and how that is evidenced? [Traceability, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the 1-second performance target tied to a defined data volume and measurement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
